digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI, main text; Mgombato (mtsai, tsorera)

teaser.en: Its name means 'little witch', and Digo, English, German, Italian and Swahili all independently accuse it of witchcraft.
teaser.sw: Jina lake maana yake ni 'mchawi mdogo', na Kidigo, Kiingereza, Kijerumani, Kiitaliano na Kiswahili, kila kimoja kwa njia yake, kinaushutumu kwa uchawi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'mtsai mdide', na Chidigo, Chingereza, Chijerumani, Chitaliana na Chiswahili, chila luga kpwa njiraye, bila kuiga luga yanjina, zinachiona kukala ni mtsai.

summary.en: *Chitsai*, witchweed, is a small, pretty weed that steals from the roots of maize and ruins the harvest. To Digo farmers it bewitches the crop, and remarkably, many other languages give it a witch's name too.
summary.sw: *Chitsai*, kichawi (kiduha), ni gugu dogo zuri linaloiba kutoka kwenye mizizi ya mahindi na kuharibu mavuno. Kwa wakulima wa Kidigo hulaga mazao, na cha kushangaza, lugha nyingine nyingi pia zinaupa jina la mchawi.
summary.dg: *Chitsai* (kpwa Chingereza *witchweed*) ni mbondo mdide wenye maruwa manono, unaoiya chakurya kula kpwa mizi ya pemba na kubananga mavuno. Kpwa Adigo akurima, chitsai chinaanga mimea ya munda; na dzambo ra ajabu ni kukala luga nyinji zanjina piya zinachiiha kpwa dzina ra mtsai.

about.en: Witchweed is a small, upright herb, usually 15 to 30 cm tall, with rough, narrow leaves and small, bright flowers, typically red or scarlet with a yellow eye. It looks harmless, but it is a parasite. Its roots fasten onto the roots of maize, sorghum, rice and other grasses and draw water and nutrients from them. Much of the damage is done underground before the weed even appears, leaving the crop stunted and yellow. Each plant sets huge numbers of dust-like seeds that can wait in the soil for years.
about.sw: Kichawi ni mmea mdogo unaosimama wima, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa sm 15 hadi 30, wenye majani membamba yanayokwaruza na maua madogo angavu, kwa kawaida mekundu au mekundu iliyokolea yenye jicho la manjano. Huonekana kuwa usio na madhara, lakini ni kimelea. Mizizi yake hujifunga kwenye mizizi ya mahindi, mtama, mpunga na nyasi nyingine na kufyonza maji na virutubisho kutoka kwayo. Sehemu kubwa ya uharibifu hufanyika chini ya ardhi hata kabla gugu halijatokea, na kuacha mazao yamedumaa na kugeuka manjano. Kila mmea huzaa idadi kubwa mno ya mbegu zilizo kama vumbi ambazo zinaweza kungoja udongoni kwa miaka.
about.dg: *Chitsai* ni mmea mdide uimao, mara nyinji wa sentimita 15 hadi 30, wenye makodza membamba ganayokaraza na maruwa madide ganayong'ala, mara nyinji ga kundu, na kahi-kahi ga rangi ya mandano. Chinaonekana dza tachina ubaya, ela chinaishi kpwa kuiya chakurya cha mimea yanjina. Miziye inagbwira mizi ya pemba, mhama, mphunga na nyasi zanjina, na inaiya madzi na chakurya cha mimea hiyo. Ubaya unji unahendwa tsini, hata kabla chitsai chidzangbweonekana, na mimea ya munda inasala inarunda na ya rangi ya mandano. Chila mmea unalavya tembe nyinji sana dza vumbi, ambazo zinaweza kusala ulongoni kpwa myaka minji.

where.en: It grows in farms, especially maize fields on poor, worn-out soils, across Africa and tropical Asia.
where.sw: Huota mashambani, hasa katika mashamba ya mahindi yenye udongo duni uliochoka, kote Afrika na maeneo ya tropiki ya Asia.
where.dg: Chinamera mindani, hasa minda ya pemba yenye ulongo wa chitsapi uriochoka, kpwenye tsi za Afrika na za Asia za dzoho.

culture.en: Pakia records that Digo farmers read *chitsai* as a sign of low fertility and poor harvests. To them it does more than signal bad soil: it bewitches the crops and magically spoils the yield. Science explains the same loss as parasitism. The plant's name warns the farmer that it prevents a good harvest, especially of maize. Mgombato has a verb, *tsorera*, for bewitching someone's farm and ruining their crops through witchcraft.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba wakulima wa Kidigo husoma *chitsai* kama ishara ya rutuba duni na mavuno mabaya. Kwao, haionyeshi tu udongo mbaya: hulaga mazao na kuharibu mavuno kwa uchawi. Sayansi inaeleza hasara hiyo hiyo kama ukimelea. Jina la mmea linamwonya mkulima kwamba unazuia mavuno mazuri, hasa ya mahindi. Mgombato ina kitenzi, *tsorera*, cha kulaga shamba la mtu na kuharibu mazao yake kwa uchawi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala akurima a Chidigo anachiona *chitsai* dza alama ya ulongo wa chitsapi na mavuno machache. Kpwao, chitsai si alama tu ya ulongo usio mnono: chinaanga mimea ya munda na kubananga mavuno kpwa utsai. Sayansi inaonyesa hasara iyo kukala ni kpwa sababu chitsai chinaiya chakurya cha mimea yanjina (*parasitism*). Dzina ra mmea hinyu rinamuonya mkurima kukala chinazuwiya mavuno manono, hasa ga pemba. Mgombato ina neno *tsorera*, renye mana ya kuanga munda wa mutu na kubananga mimeaye kpwa utsai.

names.en: *Chitsai* comes from *mtsai*, witch; Mgombato glosses *mtsai* as 'witch, magician, sorcerer'. The prefix *chi-* marks the plant's small size. Pakia points out a striking coincidence. The plant is 'witchweed' in English, *Teufelszwirn* ('devil's thread') in German and *strega* ('witch') in Italian. In Swahili it is *kichawi*, 'witch', and the Latin genus name *Striga* refers to a witch-like woman with magical powers. These languages share the idea, not the word, and none of them borrowed it from another.
names.sw: *Chitsai* linatokana na *mtsai*, mchawi; Mgombato analieleza *mtsai* kama 'mchawi, mganga wa mazingaombwe, mlozi'. Kiambishi *chi-* kinaonyesha udogo wa mmea. Pakia anaonyesha mfanano wa kushangaza. Kwa Kiingereza mmea huu ni *witchweed* ('gugu la mchawi'), kwa Kijerumani *Teufelszwirn* ('uzi wa shetani') na kwa Kiitaliano *strega* ('mchawi'). Kwa Kiswahili ni *kichawi*, 'mchawi', na jina la jenasi la Kilatini *Striga* linarejelea mwanamke kama mchawi mwenye nguvu za kimiujiza. Lugha hizi zinashiriki wazo, si neno, na hakuna hata moja iliyoliazima kutoka kwa nyingine.
names.dg: *Chitsai* rinalavywa kula *mtsai*; Mgombato inaandika *mtsai* kukala ni mutu wa utsai (*witch, magician, sorcerer*). Mwandzo wa neno, *chi-*, unaonyesa kukala mmea ni mdide. Pakia anaonyesa dzambo ra ajabu. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *witchweed*, kpwa Chijerumani *Teufelszwirn* ('uzi wa shetani'), na kpwa Chitaliana *strega* ('mtsai'). Kpwa Chiswahili ni *kichawi*, 'mtsai', na dzina ra jenasi ra Chilatini, *Striga*, rina mana ya mchetu dza mtsai mwenye nguvu za utsai. Luga hizi zinahalana kpwa mana, si kpwa neno, na takuna luga iriyoazima neno hiri kula kpwa yanjina.

reason.dg: *Matsere*, pemba, mmea wa munda ambao chitsai chinauvamira

reason.en: Weed that signals a good harvest
reason.dg: Mbondo inayoonyesa kukala mavuno gandakala manono

reason.en: Itch grass, another weed of poor fields
reason.sw: Nyasi inayowasha (itch grass), gugu jingine la mashamba duni
reason.dg: *Mwambanyama*, mbondo yanjina ya minda yenye ulongo wa chitsapi

reason.en: Cowpea, grown to restore poor fields
reason.sw: Kunde, zinazopandwa kurejesha rutuba ya mashamba duni
reason.dg: *Kunde*, inayophandwa ili kuuyiza unono wa ulongo wa minda iriyochoka
